UNDERSTAND THE PRODUCT

Product description

Shiva Exim lists sorghum (jowar) grain for animal feed. Buyers should provide the feed-grain specification, including moisture, broken grain, foreign matter, damaged grain and required contaminant testing.

This is a feed-grain enquiry, not planting seed. Feed-quality requirements and lot evidence are confirmed before an order.

Common applications

Animal and poultry feed; feed milling and compound-feed processing.

Specification status

Product form, quality limits, availability and lot test results are agreed with the final offer.
